meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

scientific_integrity.detail: Accurate representation of FlowIO capabilities with clear boundaries (does not perform compensation, transforms, or gating) and precise preprocessing semantics

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for low-level FCS I/O with explicit direction to FlowKit for downstream analysis

methodological_ground.detail: Based on FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 specifications with documented preprocessing equations and FCS standard compliance

code_usability.detail: All code examples are syntactically correct with proper file handling and validation patterns

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of FCS operations including read (metadata/events), multi-dataset files, write FCS 3.1, with excellent reference organization and bundled inspector

reliability.note: Excellent reliability with 6-point operating workflow, validation by reopening, non-negotiable checks (6 rules), and troubleshooting reference

performance_context.note: Well-organized documentation (310 lines) with clear critical semantics section, 5 comprehensive reference files, and bundled inspector script

agent_usability.note: Exceptional with detailed critical semantics (TEXT normalization, two event representations, channel numbering), operating workflow, and clear FlowKit boundary

human_usability.note: Clear installation with version confirmation; quick start for read/multi-dataset/write; bundled inspector with uv run pattern; metadata sensitivity warnings

security.note: Good security with metadata sensitivity warnings (sample/subject/operator identifiers), strict parsing by default; minor: lacks guidance on untrusted FCS files

maintainability.note: Excellent structure with version 2.0, clear license (BSD-3-Clause), 5 comprehensive references, version pinning (FlowIO 1.4.0, verified 2026-07-23), and authoritative FCS spec citations

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with allowed-tools and NumPy integration; bundled inspector script; minor: memory-mapped access limitations mentioned but not workarounded

key_strengths: Exceptional semantic clarity with Critical Semantics section covering TEXT normalization, two event representations, channel numbering, and write limitations
Outstanding boundary definition clearly distinguishing FlowIO (low-level I/O) from FlowKit (compensation, transforms, gating) to prevent misuse
Excellent validation culture with 6-point operating workflow emphasizing 'Validate writes by reopening' and round-trip verification examples
Strong privacy awareness with metadata sensitivity warnings about sample/subject/operator identifiers and bundled inspector privacy controls
Comprehensive non-negotiable checks (6 rules) preventing common errors like passing 2D arrays to create_fcs or assuming TEXT keys retain $ prefix

recommendations.title: Document memory limit configuration for inspector
recommendations.problem: Inspector mentions memory limits in --help but not detailed in main documentation
recommendations.root_cause: Bundled Inspector section focuses on basic usage without parameter details
recommendations.fix: Add note: 'Use --max-input-size (default 128 MiB) and --max-array-size (default 512 MiB) to protect against resource exhaustion with large FCS files'

recommendations.title: Add preprocessing side effect example for write_fcs
recommendations.problem: Warning about PnG/timestep changes affecting round-trip mentioned but not demonstrated
recommendations.root_cause: Copy or Rewrite section describes behavior without illustrative example
recommendations.fix: Add brief example showing how dropping PnG during write_fcs changes subsequent as_array(preprocess=True) results, emphasizing validation of both representations

recommendations.title: Add guidance for untrusted FCS files
recommendations.problem: No discussion of handling potentially malicious FCS files
recommendations.root_cause: Security focuses on metadata sensitivity without addressing adversarial inputs
recommendations.fix: Add security note: 'When loading FCS files from untrusted sources, use only_text=True first and validate event_count, channel_count, and version before loading full event data'
